text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I had no idea there was a math reference 
book this easy to follow! Air Groove-san 
really is so reliable.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, didn't I tell you? Leave it to Air 
Groove-senpai, and everything's perfect!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Dober, how about this reference 
book for you? It illustrates the 
fundamentals of sports nutrition with 
diagrams, making it quite accessible.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
A recommendation from Air 
Groove-senpai...! Yes! I'll buy it and 
read it right away!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
(Fufu... Dober's eyes are sparkling! Well, 
she is her idolized senior after all.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right! Air Groove-senpai, is there 
anywhere you'd like to go?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
You've helped us so much, Senpai. I'll 
gladly accompany you anywhere!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Is this place... a drugstore?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I heard herbal medicine can be effective 
for sleepless nights. ...A junior of mine 
has recently been troubled by trouble 
falling asleep.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: ? Dober...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Kh. Um, Air Groove-senpai!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
If you'd like... how about aromatherapy 
too?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
There's a fragrance I'd recommend for a 
deep sleep! Blending their favorite scents 
might help your junior relax, too...!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Oh? That is quite intriguing. Please, do 
tell me more.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, dashing off to deliver it right 
away... Her sense of responsibility is 
something I truly need to learn from.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
? ...Ryan, what's wrong? You're zoning 
out.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
...No, it's just. I was thinking about how 
amazing you are, Dober.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Doing something for someone who feels so 
out of reach... I always worry it might 
just be meddling or an unwanted favor.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I often find myself hesitating and unable 
to act because of that.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, so you think like that too, Ryan. 
...Though, I totally get that feeling.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Even so, the reason I could muster my 
courage was—because I simply wanted to be 
of help to Senpai, I guess.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: ! You wanted... to be of help...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I mean, she's the senior I look up to so 
much. ...What about you, Ryan?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
...I want to be of help too. I want to 
reach out a hand and ask if she's okay.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Being honest with your own 
feelings is what truly matters, right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
All that's left is taking that one step 
forward... I'm sure you can support her, 
Ryan.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Dober...!

text_block_list.name: Trainer
text_block_list.text:
One day, I spotted Mejiro Ryan deep in 
thought. Come to think of it, she had a 
gloomy expression while working out the 
other day...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainer! No, it's nothing major, but—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
There's a horse girl I really want to be 
of help to! So I was wondering what I 
might need for that... or something.
choice_data_list:
The 'kindness' behind that worry is 
already plenty of help!

To be helpful, maybe being 'dependable' is 
the key?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer! Still, I wonder... Normally, 
this sort of thing—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
—Oh. Is that girl going to be okay? 
Carrying such heavy luggage...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, Trainer, I'll go call out to 
her! If there's one thing I'm confident 
in, it's my strength!

text_block_list.name: Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Watching her sprint over with such dash, 
her back seemed overflowing with pure 
kindness.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I see, you're totally right! Now, how to 
train that up...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Ryan-oneesama~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Um~, there was something I wished to ask 
regarding training methods~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Of course! I'd love to help if I can. 
Let's train together after school!

text_block_list.name: Trainer
text_block_list.text:
As Mejiro Ryan spoke with such brightness, 
her profile was filled with dependable 
strength.
